items.claim: I could use 4 of 9 parking lots.
items.reason: Parking quality lists 9 total lots and 4 usable lots.

items.claim: Across the usable lots, a typical weekday was emptiest at 03:00 with 25.4% occupancy and fullest at 12:00 with 43.5%.
items.reason: The typical weekday trough is 03:00 at 25.4% and the peak is 12:00 at 43.5%.

items.claim: The weekend effect was not the same everywhere.
items.reason: The pooled parking result says the weekend effect differs between series.

items.claim: Elbauenpark - Messeparkplatz was fuller on weekends by 7.8 percentage points, while Tiefgarage Friedensplatz was emptier by 13.7 percentage points and Tiefgarage Ulrichshaus was emptier by 15.6 percentage points.
items.reason: All three weekend-effect magnitudes and directions match, and all are significant.

items.claim: Tiefgarage Hotel Maritim showed no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: Hotel Maritim's weekend effect is marked significant false.

items.claim: Compared with July, only Tiefgarage Hotel Maritim was fuller, by 13.9 percentage points at equal hour and weekday.
items.reason: Hotel Maritim is the only parking lot with a significant positive adjusted shift, at 13.9 points.

items.claim: Elbauenpark - Messeparkplatz, Tiefgarage Friedensplatz, and Tiefgarage Ulrichshaus showed no measurable change.
items.reason: Those three lots are all listed as having no significant change month on month.

items.claim: I could use 15 of 18 charging stations.
items.reason: EV charging has 18 total stations and 15 usable stations.

items.claim: Across those stations, a typical weekday was quietest at 04:00 with 8.3% charging point occupancy and busiest at 11:00 with 30.9%.
items.reason: The typical weekday trough is 04:00 at 8.3% and the peak is 11:00 at 30.9%.

items.claim: The weekend effect differed between stations: some were busier on weekends, some were less busy, and several showed no measurable change.
items.reason: The pooled result says weekend effects differ, and the station results include positive, negative, and non-significant weekend effects.

items.claim: Among the most notable stations, Breiter Weg 203 was busier than in July by 17.9 percentage points at equal hour and weekday.
items.reason: Breiter Weg 203 has a significant adjusted increase of 17.9 percentage points versus July.

items.claim: Its mean occupancy was 44.6% after 25.6%, and no charging point was free for 31.0% of known time.
items.reason: Breiter Weg 203 had mean occupancy 44.6% versus 25.6% in July, and all points were busy for 31.0% of known time.

items.claim: Am Blauen Bock 3 was less busy than in July by 22.1 percentage points, with a mean of 20.0% after 42.6%; no charging point was free for 7.2% of known time.
items.reason: Am Blauen Bock 3 has a significant adjusted decrease of 22.1 points, mean occupancy 20.0% versus 42.6%, and 7.2% fully busy time.

items.claim: Hegelstraße 4 was also one of the busier sites, with no charging point free for 23.4% of known time, and it was less busy on weekends by 10.2 percentage points.
items.reason: Hegelstraße 4 is among the highest-occupancy stations, had 23.4% fully busy time, and a significant weekend effect of -10.2 points.

items.claim: Across the 13 stations that were comparable with July, only Breiter Weg 203 was busier and only Am Blauen Bock 3 was less busy.
items.reason: There were 13 comparable stations, with only Breiter Weg 203 significantly higher and only Am Blauen Bock 3 significantly lower.

items.claim: The other comparable stations showed no measurable change.
items.reason: All other comparable EV charging stations are listed as having no significant change.

items.claim: For NO2, all 4 stations were usable.
items.reason: NO2 has 4 total stations, all 4 are listed as usable, and none are excluded.

items.claim: Across them, a typical weekday peaked at 09:00 with 25.5 µg/m³ and was lowest at 04:00 with 10.8 µg/m³.
items.reason: The NO2 typical weekday peaks at 09:00 with 25.5 µg/m³ and bottoms at 04:00 with 10.8 µg/m³.

items.claim: The weekend effect differed by station: City Tunnel was cleaner on weekends by 9.3 µg/m³ and Guericke Strasse was cleaner by 4.8 µg/m³, while Schleinufer and West showed no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: The pooled test says weekend effects differ, with significant decreases at City Tunnel and Guericke Strasse and no significant change at Schleinufer or West.

items.claim: No NO2 station exceeded the EU hourly limit of 200 µg/m³.
items.reason: Each NO2 station has EU hourly limit 200 µg/m³ with count_over equal to 0 hours.

items.claim: The WHO daily guideline of 25 µg/m³ was exceeded on 17 days at City Tunnel, on 3 days at Guericke Strasse, on 3 days at Schleinufer, and not at West.
items.reason: The WHO daily guideline exceedance counts are 17, 3, 3, and 0 days respectively.

items.claim: Compared with July, NO2 was more polluted at City Tunnel by 6.8 µg/m³, at Guericke Strasse by 4.7 µg/m³, and at West by 1.8 µg/m³.
items.reason: All three stations have significant positive adjusted shifts of 6.8, 4.7, and 1.8 µg/m³.

items.claim: Schleinufer showed no measurable change.
items.reason: Schleinufer's adjusted month-on-month shift is not significant.

items.claim: For O3, West was usable.
items.reason: O3 has one station, West, and it is listed as usable with no exclusions.

items.claim: Its typical day was lowest at 08:00 with 46.6 µg/m³ and highest at 18:00 with 102.1 µg/m³.
items.reason: West's fitted weekday trough is at 08:00 with 46.6 µg/m³ and peak at 18:00 with 102.1 µg/m³.

items.claim: There was no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: West's O3 weekend effect is not significant.

items.claim: Health limits were exceeded: the WHO 8-hour guideline of 100 µg/m³ on 15 days and the EU 8-hour target of 120 µg/m³ on 7 days, with a worst 8-hour mean of 151.1 µg/m³.
items.reason: West exceeded the WHO guideline on 15 days and the EU target on 7 days, with worst 8-hour mean 151.1 µg/m³.

items.claim: Compared with July, there was no measurable change, even though the raw mean was 73.4 µg/m³ after 69.1 µg/m³.
items.reason: The adjusted shift is not significant, while the raw means are 73.4 µg/m³ in August and 69.1 µg/m³ in July.

items.claim: For PM10, no station was usable because the readings were too stale: unchanged from the previous hour in 61% of hours at Guericke Strasse, 59% at Schleinufer, and 71% at West.
items.reason: PM10 has no usable stations, and all three exclusions are for stale readings at 61%, 59%, and 71% of hours.

items.claim: For PM2.5, no station was usable for the same reason: unchanged from the previous hour in 72% of hours at Guericke Strasse, 70% at Schleinufer, and 78% at West.
items.reason: PM2.5 has no usable stations, and all three exclusions are for stale readings at 72%, 70%, and 78% of hours.
